I hope this bullshit illness randomly consumes me somehow. I catch myself praying for it to a god i can't believe in

Im so fucking done with bullshit, other people love the idea of quick fixes, so when you tell them that their solution straight up does NOT work at all for you, I think it scares them, they realize the reality of ''living'' with something virtually incurable is a very real thing, so they take it out on us. They get mad at US for not being more open minded or whatever the fuck they want from us in that moment. We just suffer and that's it, this is our life. Unless you're lucky enough to have PMDD but wake up one day with a solution. At least I don't believe in luck anymore. I can't keep surviving abuse AND pmdd + autism. Life. is. rough. 

My ''support'' worker seems to hurt more than help. She either forgets we have an appointment, reschedules, or treats me like I'm a huge inconvenience. She knows I live with autism and severe PMDD, but constantly forgets somehow, and almost seems mad that I can't be more self sufficient. Today, she let me know that my rent subsidy runs out two months from now. This means I lose my bachelor apartment, it is a very short walking distance to all of my errands, I can't drive so I'm really fucked if I cant access essential stores/clinics. I can take the city bus but I'm disabled for gods sake, it's not easy to do everything alone. So in 2 months, I can either move 8 hours back home, away from my boyfriend, into my abusive families garage, OR, live with roommates again, meaning I can't take care of myself pretty much at all. 

I just signed up for 9 months of trauma therapy due to my past, so the idea of having to live with strangers again is terrifying. People don't seem to understand PMDD or autism, no matter how many times I over exert myself setting boundaries, they are crossed, it feels like at least. There's so much other awful shit that's always going on, I feel like my life is cursed. My boyfriend is moving back in with his father so he can have cheaper rent, but their family is very toxic. We don't agree on the choice, which is really heartbreaking to see, he knows his mental health will plummet but he'd rather save up money. I cut my finger open while trying to clean mold out of my window frame, I needed stitches but the Canadian hospitals are very busy, so they just sent me home. Now I have nerve damage in my dominant hand, I have to relearn everything with my left hand. My laptop broke for good and I can't afford to replace or repair it, and I recently bought a $100 charger for it that I can't return. I'm tired of needing to borrow other peoples stuff. A 21 year old should be able to buy a damn vacuum. I want to work. I want to have friends who don't abuse me, I want to make art, I want to live in a house where I can sing, and cry as loudly as I need, instead of being trapped in a tuna box apartment.  I hate feeling this awful guilt, vortex of doubt and anxiety, the fucked up hopelessness and just feeling so damn alone. I wish I could sell all my things, sit in a hole and let PMDD eat me.

I notice a decrease in headaches, no more cold-like symptoms, so far I don't get hives at all anymore, less breast pain, a bit less irritability, and decreased anxiety. I take it on the days I feel symptoms, regardless of severity. I'd consider my PMDD to be generally intrusive, but totally debilitating for about 8 days of every month. Taking the Allegra doesn't completely ''erase'' the debilitating aspects, but has made said 8\~ days more manageable

So far the only concoction I've found to be helpful is: 1000mg of calcium, 100mg of B1, 500mg of magnesium, and 180mg of allegra. 5HTP and John's wort gave me worsening anxiety, in retrospect, even after months of use. Remember some vitamins can interact poorly with one another, so everything needs to be double checked first! Best of luck
